# logs
> Structured logs, error capture and retention.

kind: area module (owns app code in place; see module.json "owns", longest prefix wins)
tier: shareable
core: true  toggleable: false
always-on features: error-logs
gate: off for a customer product without an active entitlement => routes 404, no menu, crons skipped, data retained. Owned products: always on.
rules: no owner names in code; server-side authz; behavior changes need a golden/regression test.
